PLHA loans and grants are public funds under 1720(b)(1) and (b)(4) (https://california.public.law/codes/labor_code_section_1720), but 1720(c)(5)(E) (below-market loans with at least 40 percent of units restricted 20 years at or below 80 percent AMI), 1720(c)(5)(C) (mortgage, down payment or single-family rehab aid to a household) and 1720(c)(3) de minimis can apply. Davis-Bacon applies only if HOME (12+ HOME units, 24 CFR 92.354) or CDBG (8+ units, 24 CFR 570.603) is layered. The request is to use County PLHA AOWH funds to buy land for moderate-income for-sale homes built by a City-selected developer (report 26-261, https://legistar.granicus.com/Monterey/attachments/3aa10ea9-740a-42ea-afbd-7ee3960877e7.pdf; Attachment A, https://legistar.granicus.com/Monterey/attachments/e454e9b4-bab8-4d6a-9ba5-85cd8ae39ceb.pdf). Land acquisition is not construction, and down payment aid to buyers is exempt under 1720(c)(5)(C), but a land write-down to the developer is public funds under 1720(b)(3).
